newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Paris mayor, under investigation, visits Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Paris mayor, under investigation, visits Morocco.

text.p: Paris Mayor Jean Tiberi, under investigation on suspicion of misusing public funds, showed his determination to pursue his work on Thursday, turning up in Marrakesh for a meeting of mayors.
"I have nothing to add to what I have already said," he told Reuters shortly after arriving in the southern city with his wife, Xaviere, who is also being investigated.

In a statement earlier on Thursday, Tiberi vowed to stay in his job and said he was being formally investigated over a payment made to his wife out of public funds and paid into the couple's join bank account.
"It is being wrongly alleged that I intervened to have my wife hired by the Essone (area near Paris) General Council," he said.
He said neither he nor his wife had anything with which to reproach themselves and "I will carry on with my mission."
Moroccan Interior Minister Driss Basri was attending the two-day meeting which groups mayors from main cities in predominantly French-speaking countries.
